news.headline: Reach Capital raises $265M Fund V to back AI founders building to ‘expand human potential’
news.summary: Reach Capital closed its fifth fund at $265M, oversubscribed and focused on backing AI founders committed to expanding human potential. The firm continues its thesis of investing in founders using artificial intelligence to solve meaningful problems.

news.headline: Prediction market traders see roughly 1-in-4 odds Paramount’s bid to buy Warner Bros. Discovery fails
news.summary: Prediction market traders are pricing in about 25% odds that Paramount's proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery falls through—up from before the recent 12-state lawsuit but down from when the deal stalled in late July. The shifting probabilities reflect uncertainty around regulatory headwinds versus continued momentum toward closing.

educational.title: What Actually Happens When You Buy a Stock
points: You're buying a tiny slice of real ownership in a company, not a lottery ticket
Your broker matches your order with a seller through an exchange in milliseconds
Stock price moves on collective belief about future profits, not just today's news
You make money two ways: the price rising, or dividends paid out over time
Owning one share still makes you a part-owner, with voting rights and all
